0022600223.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, 13th in the East) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 3-3 at home, 11th in the West) in the Nets' 11th game of 2026-27, with Brooklyn having lost its last two and New Orleans its last three. Egor Demin is out for Brooklyn with a leg bruise, and Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with rest, a game-time decision, after averaging 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes this season. For New Orleans, Yves Missi is out with a knee bruise, while Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) and Zion Williamson (rest) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Nets losing 116-113 in New Orleans on January 14, 2026, their most recent meeting.
